brief: Budget Go: a simple personal budget tracker for everyday users. User-selected stack: Next.js with TypeScript; visual direction: minimal with subtle glassmorphism; small specialist team. Proposed first milestone, subject to refinement: income and expense tracking, categories, monthly budgets and an overview dashboard. Storage, authentication, currency and integrations are undecided: do not assume browser-only storage or a hosted database. Current host is DeepSeek Harness, which has no dedicated toolkit adapter; use the codex-compatible AGENTS.md and .agents/skills layout as a portable layout only, without claiming verified native skill discovery. Generate project guidance first, then implement the first useful milestone after clarifying any blocking product decisions.
audience: Everyday users managing their personal budgets
